name: vinglish-zero-launch-film
description: A three-minute Remotion launch film for Vinglish Zero.

scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/vinglish-zero-launch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --concurrency=6
scripts.render:preview: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/vinglish-zero-preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --scale=0.5 --concurrency=6
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/keyframe.png --frame=2250
